  neighbor swp3 activate
  neighbor swp4 activate
  neighbor swp5 activate
  neighbor swp6 activate
  advertise-all-vni
 exit-address-family
exit
!
end

 evpn mh uplink
exit
!
router bgp 65111
 bgp router-id 10.0.0.11
 neighbor swp1 interface remote-as external
 neighbor swp1 advertisement-interval 0
 neighbor swp1 timers 3 9
 neighbor swp1 timers connect 10
 neighbor swp2 interface remote-as external
 neighbor swp2 advertisement-interval 0
 neighbor swp2 timers 3 9
 neighbor swp2 timers connect 10
 !
 address-family ipv4 unicast
  redistribute connected
  neighbor swp1 allowas-in 1
  neighbor swp2 allowas-in 1
  maximum-paths 64
  maximum-paths ibgp 64
 exit-address-family
 !
 address-family l2vpn evpn
  neighbor swp1 activate
  neighbor swp1 allowas-in 1
  neighbor swp2 activate
  neighbor swp2 allowas-in 1
  advertise-all-vni
  vni 50001
   route-target import 65000:50001
   route-target export 65000:50001
  exit-vni
  vni 10110
   route-target import 65000:10110
   route-target export 65000:10110
  exit-vni
 exit-address-family
exit
!
router bgp 65111 vrf tenant-k8s
 bgp router-id 10.0.0.11
 neighbor 10.167.10.11 remote-as 65010
 neighbor 10.167.10.11 advertisement-interval 0
 neighbor 10.167.10.11 timers 3 9

 exit-address-family
